name: Odometer
description: A number shown on turning wheels that roll and carry over like a mechanical counter.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to show. When it changes, the lowest wheel that has a readable distance to go rolls there and each wheel to its left turns as the one beside it passes from 9 to 0, a little later and a little slower. Wheels below it spin once and land. Through zero, the wheels roll down to 0 and up again while the minus sign comes or goes.

props.name: format
props.description: Formatting, as for Intl.NumberFormat: currency, percent, fraction digits, grouping. Group separators, the decimal mark, currency and percent signs sit between the windows as plain text and stay aligned.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for formatting. Fixed by default so the server and the browser agree.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds the lowest moving wheel takes. Wheels further left start 70ms later each and take 14% longer. Under reduced motion the number changes at once.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the number, on its baseline.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content after the number, on its baseline, such as a unit in a smaller size.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root span. Set the size with a text utility; the wheels scale with it. Other span props are passed through.
